own_solution.law: Thin-rod longitudinal wave speed v = sqrt(E/rho); free-free fundamental lambda_rod = 2L, f = v/(2L); air nodes spaced lambda_air/2 = v_air/(2f) = v_air L / v
assumptions: clamp at the middle is a node, ends free
air columns resonate at the rod's frequency

notes: v = sqrt(7e10/2700) = 5091.75 m/s; f = 5091.75/2.4 = 2121.6 Hz; spacing = 343*1.2/5091.75 = 0.080837 m (8.08 cm). Lengthened to 1.52 m with the clamp then fitted at the new middle: 343*1.52/5091.75 = 0.102393 m. Cross-section/diameter cancel (mass and stiffness both scale with area); both values keep the rod thin. The diameter (8.21 mm -> 0.529 cm^2) and the 1.6 cm^2 cross-section are inconsistent with each other, but they are separate sentences never added together, so no contradiction within any single item. Variant checks: TD83B/T3295/TA297/T2604 all 32 cm; T94AF/T9574 8.21 mm; T641F/T1BAE 1.6 cm^2; TFBD6/TFE55 numeral-free.
